Players Committee card image of [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on your alien or Rebel. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, if destiny +2 > defense value. If hit by Luke or Owen, target's forfeit = 0 and you retrieve 1 Force. Once during your move phase, may fire at a Jawa or Undercover spy.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/lukeshuntingrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
